g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
g.text: J5 CELL3P, J6 CELL2P, J7 CELL1P (24 AWG)

g.desc: J5 CELL3P, J6 CELL2P, J7 CELL1P (24 AWG)

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
g.text: Stack I2C_A connects directly to U1.

g.desc: Stack I2C_A connects directly to U1.

g.text: Pull-ups are on EPS; no STM32 bridge.

g.desc: Pull-ups are on EPS; no STM32 bridge.

g.text: CFETOFF and DFETOFF are hardware inputs.

g.desc: CFETOFF and DFETOFF are hardware inputs.

g.text: Host configuration required before FET enable.

g.desc: Host configuration required before FET enable.

g.text: REG1 is disabled at reset; C18 retained.

g.desc: REG1 is disabled at reset; C18 retained.

g.text: Cold start needs independent host power

g.desc: Cold start needs independent host power

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.4000; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
g.text: 1. Power path: BAT_TOP > F1 > SW1 > Q4 CHG > FET_MID > Q4 DSG > PACK_INT > Q3 deploy inhibit > PACK_P > J12.

g.desc: 1. Power path: BAT_TOP > F1 > SW1 > Q4 CHG > FET_MID > Q4 DSG > PACK_INT > Q3 deploy inhibit > PACK_P > J12.

g.text: BQ BAT and VC16 are tapped at BAT_TOP before F1/SW1 (unswitched).

g.desc: BQ BAT and VC16 are tapped at BAT_TOP before F1/SW1 (unswitched).

g.text: 2. BAT_N (= BQ VSS) exists only on the cell side of RS1. PGND = PACK- = stack PGND. RS1 is the only link.

g.desc: 2. BAT_N (= BQ VSS) exists only on the cell side of RS1. PGND = PACK- = stack PGND. RS1 is the only link.

g.text: 3. No DGND link on this board: I2C / FET-off lines reference PGND through the EPS star point.

g.desc: 3. No DGND link on this board: I2C / FET-off lines reference PGND through the EPS star point.

g.text: 4. Deploy inhibit: Q3 OFF by default. DEP_SW_A > R21 > J10 deploy switch > PGND turns it ON. SW1 pole 2 drives RBF_A.

g.desc: 4. Deploy inhibit: Q3 OFF by default. DEP_SW_A > R21 > J10 deploy switch > PGND turns it ON. SW1 pole 2 drives RBF_A.

g.text: 5. Stack spares: SP7 BAT_ALERT_n, SP8 HTR_EN, SP9 BAT_CFETOFF, SP10 BAT_DFETOFF. EPS NTC on THM0/AGND.

g.desc: 5. Stack spares: SP7 BAT_ALERT_n, SP8 HTR_EN, SP9 BAT_CFETOFF, SP10 BAT_DFETOFF. EPS NTC on THM0/AGND.

g.text: 6. RS1 20 mOhm. Protection thresholds and thermistor settings require host configuration; validate against the actual charge/load budget.

g.desc: 6. RS1 20 mOhm. Protection thresholds and thermistor settings require host configuration; validate against the actual charge/load budget.

g.text: 7. Cold start: power the host independently for RAM configuration, or provision validated BQ OTP settings. Verify actual AO4805 pinout.

g.desc: 7. Cold start: power the host independently for RAM configuration, or provision validated BQ OTP settings. Verify actual AO4805 pinout.

g.text: TI reference gate network: 10M + 16V zener G-S.

g.desc: TI reference gate network: 10M + 16V zener G-S.

g.text: D4/R15 = fast DSG turn-off. LD & PACK sensed after DSG FET.

g.desc: D4/R15 = fast DSG turn-off. LD & PACK sensed after DSG FET.

g.text: BQ BAT/VC16 tap is BEFORE F1/SW1 (unswitched).

g.desc: BQ BAT/VC16 tap is BEFORE F1/SW1 (unswitched).
